Rashi on Eruvin 89b:10:1.hebrew: סלוקי סליקו נפשייהו - בני קטן מגגו, ואחליה לבני גדול:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:10:1.english: They removed themselves - The residents of the small [roof removed themselves] from its roof, and relinquished it to the residents of the large [roof].

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:11:1.hebrew: הותר בכל הגגין - ואפילו לרבנן, דכיון דאינהו לא עביד סולם, סליקו נפשייהו ואחלינהו לגביה:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:11:1.english: Is permitted on all the roofs - And even according to the Rabbis; for since they did not make a ladder, they removed themselves [from them] and relinquished them to him.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:12:1.english: Built an upper story - And surrounded his entire roof with walls for the upper story.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:12:2.english: A small [opening] - A small opening open toward the side of the roofs.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:12:3.hebrew: הותר בכולן - דגלי דעתיה דקא מחזיק בהו, והם לא הקפידו לעשות כן — אחלינהו לגביה:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:12:3.english: It is permitted on all of them - For he revealed his intention that he is taking possession of them, and [since] they were not particular to do so, they relinquished [their rights] to him.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:13:1.hebrew: פעמים שהדקה לאיסור - ואפילו לרבי מאיר, דמשוי כל הגגות רשות אחת — אסור בהן:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:13:1.english: Sometimes the small partition [leads] to prohibition - And even according to Rabbi Meir, who renders all the roofs a single domain, he is forbidden [to carry] on them:

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:13:2.hebrew: דעבדה להדי תרביציה - שפתח לצד גינתו, ומחיצה של צד הגגין הניח סתומה:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:13:2.english: Where he made it toward his garden - That he made an opening toward his garden, and the partition on the side of the roofs he left sealed.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:1:1.hebrew: רשות לעצמו - קא סלקא דעתך, כל אחד יטלטל בגגו משמע:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:1:1.english: A domain in and of itself - It enters your mind [that] it means each [person] may carry on his [own] roof.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:3:1.hebrew: והני דבי שמואל תנו - אית מתניתא בידייהו דמותבי מינה תיובתא לדבי רב, דקתני: אין להן — לכל אחד — אלא גגו, דמשמע: דלא יטלטלו אלא בגגו; הא בגגו — יטלטלו:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:3:1.english: And those of the school of Shmuel taught - There is a baraita in their possession from which they raise an objection against the school of Rav, as it teaches: They have — each one — only their [own] roof, which implies that they may carry only on their [own] roof, but on their [own] roof, they may carry.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:1.hebrew: לא שמיע לי הא שמעתא - דשמואל, דנימא גוד אסיק במחיצות כי הני שאין ניכרות:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:1.english: I have not heard this teaching - [The teaching] of Shmuel, that we say "extend and raise" [gud asik] for partitions such as these, which are not discernible.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:2.english: A large roof adjacent to a small one - The large [roof] extends beyond it on this side and on that side.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:3.hebrew: הגדול מותר - לטלטל בו דיורין שבו, ואפילו לרב. דהא מחיצות של מטה שישנן בעודפו לכאן ולכאן — מחיצות הניכרות הן, וגוד אסקינהו, ואית להו גיפופי; והך פירצה שכנגד הקטן — פתחא הוי לגדול, ואין קטן אוסר עליו, דהוי כשתי חצירות ופתח ביניהם:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:3.english: The large [roof] is permitted - for its residents to carry in it, and even according to Rav. For the lower partitions that exist in its extension on this side and on that side are noticeable partitions, and [we say:] "Pull them up," and [thus] they have flanking walls; and this breach facing the small [roof] is [considered] a doorway for the large [roof], and the small [roof] does not render it forbidden, as it is like two courtyards with a doorway between them.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:4.hebrew: אבל קטן אסור - דלדידיה הוי מלואו, ולאו פתחא הוא, ואסרי עליה בני גדול:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:5:4.english: But the small [roof] is prohibited - For with respect to it, [the breach] is its full width, and it is not an entrance, and the residents of the large [roof] prohibit [carrying] upon it.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:6:1.hebrew: שיש דיורין על זה ועל זה - שעוברין כל שעה מזה לזה. הלכך, ליכא למימר גוד אסיק במחיצה התחתונה שביניהם, מפני שנדסרת היא:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:6:1.english: Where there are residents on this [roof] and on that [roof] - For they cross constantly from this [roof] to that [roof]. Therefore, one cannot say “pull and ascend” [gud asik] regarding the lower partition that is between them, because it is trampled.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:7:1.hebrew: אבל אין בהן דיורים - אמרינן בה גוד אסיק, ומותר אף הקטן. אלמא, אף במחיצה שאינה ניכרת אית ליה לשמואל גוד אסיק — דאי לאו דמחוברין הן, אין דריסה מזה לזה:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:7:1.english: However, [if] there are no residents on them - We say regarding it, "Extend and raise," and even [carrying on] the small [roof] is permitted. It follows that even with regard to a partition that is not conspicuous, Shmuel holds [the principle of] "Extend and raise," for if they were not joined, there would be no treading from one to the other.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:8:1.hebrew: שיש מחיצה על זה ועל זה - כל סביבותיהן, חוץ מכנגד חבורן, דהשתא מישתרי גדול בגיפופי:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:8:1.english: That there is a partition on this [one] and on that [one] - [Around] all their sides, except opposite their junction, so that now the large [roof] is permitted by means of [its] flanks:

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:8:2.hebrew: אבל אין מחיצה לא לכאן ולא לכאן שניהן אסורין - דקטן נמי אסר אגדול, דהואיל ולא הוו גיפופי ממש אלא על ידי גוד אסיק, לא הוו גיפופי לשוויה פתחא לגביה, דפתחא דמינכר בעינן, וכה"ג לא עבדי אינשי:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:8:2.english: However, if there is no partition, neither to this [roof] nor to that [roof], both of them are prohibited - For the smaller [roof] also renders the larger [roof] prohibited, since, because there are no actual doorposts, but rather [only] by means of [the principle of] “extend and raise” [the walls], they are not [valid] doorposts to render it [considered] a doorway relative to it; for we require a recognizable doorway, and people do not make [doorways] in this manner.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:9:1.hebrew: אי אמרי לכו דיורין - אם הזכרתי לכם שום דירה בדבר, כך אמרתי לכם — רב יוסף חלה ושכח תלמודו:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:9:1.english: If I spoke to you of residents - If I mentioned to you any [matter of] residence regarding this, this is what I said to you — [for] Rav Yosef had fallen ill and forgotten his learning.

Rashi on Eruvin 89b:9:2.hebrew: לא שנו - דקטן אסור, בין לדיורי קטן בין לדיורי גדול, אלא שיש מחיצה ראויה לדירה; כלומר, מחיצה קבוע וקיימא, דתרוייהו גלו דעתייהו דבעו אשתמושי כל חד בדידיה. הלכך, גדול מותר בשלו — דפתחא הוא, ולא אסר קטן עלייהו; וקטן אסור לשניהם — משום דנפרץ במלואו לגדול, ואסרי עליה בני גדול, ולדידהו נמי לא מישתרי, דכיון דעבד ליה מריה מחיצה קבועה לא סליק נפשיה מיניה ולא אחלי לגבייהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 89b:9:2.english: They taught [this] only - That the small [roof] is forbidden, both to the residents of the small [roof] and to the residents of the large [roof], [only] where there is a partition fit for residence; that is to say, a fixed and established partition, as both of them revealed their intention that each wants to make use of his own [area]. Therefore, the large [roof] is permitted in its own [domain] — for [the opening] is an entrance, and the small [roof] does not prohibit [carrying] upon them; and the small [roof] is forbidden to both of them — because it is breached in its entirety into the large [roof], and the residents of the large [roof] prohibit [carrying] upon him; and for them [the residents of the large roof] it is also not permitted, since because its owner made a permanent partition for it, he did not remove himself from it and did not waive [his rights] in their favor.

Tosafot on Eruvin 89b:12:1.hebrew: ועשה לפניה דקה ד' הותר בכל הגגין - לפי מה שמפרש בכיצד מעברין (לעיל עירובין דף נט: ושם סא.) דדקה היא מחיצה, מפרש ר"י הכא, דכשבנה עלייה ועשה מחיצה כל סביב גגו ופתחה לצד הגגין, ועשה לפני הפתח דקה ד' — אז הוי תשמיש קבוע; אבל בלא דקה, ירא להשתמש שם תשמיש קבוע מפני בני גגין אחרים. וקשה, דבלא דקה נמי אמר לעיל, דאם יש מחיצה ראויה לדירה על הגדול ולא על הקטן, דאפילו קטן נמי שרי לבני גדול! ור"ח גרס: "הותרו כל הגגין". פירוש: אם עירבו שאר הגגין וזה לא עירב עמהם, אינו אוסר עליהם, דכיון דעשה דקה סילק עצמו מהם. וצריך לומר לפירושו, דלצד הגגין הוא פרוץ במילואו, או עלייה אינה אלא בחצי הגג; שאם היה כל הגג מוקף מחיצה, בלא דקה נמי לא היה אוסר. ולשון "פעמים שהדקה לאיסור" צריך ליישב, דהדקה אינה עושה לא איסור ולא היתר:
Tosafot on Eruvin 89b:12:1.english: "And erected before it a small partition four [cubits], it is permitted on all the roofs" - According to that which is explained in [the chapter] Keitzad Me'abrin (above, Eruvin 59b and there 61a) that a dakka is a partition, the Ri explains here that when one built an upper story and made a partition all around his roof, and opened [a doorway] facing the [other] roofs, and made before the doorway a dakka [of] four [cubits] — then it is considered permanent use; but without a dakka, he is afraid to use [the area] there with permanent use on account of the residents of the other roofs. And this is difficult: for even without a dakka, [the Gemara] also said above (89b) that if there is a partition suitable for a dwelling on the large [roof] and not on the small [roof], even the small [roof] is permitted to the residents of the large [roof]! And Rabbeinu Chananel had the textual reading: "All the roofs are permitted." Explanation: If the other roofs established an eruv [together] and this [owner] did not make an eruv with them, he does not prohibit [carrying] upon them, since once he made a dakka he removed himself from them. And according to his explanation, one must say that toward the side of the [other] roofs it is breached along its full width, or that the upper story occupies only half of the roof; for if the entire roof were enclosed by a partition, even without a dakka he would not prohibit [the other roofs]. And the phrasing [of Rava on 89b], "Sometimes the dakka [leads] to prohibition," must be reconciled, [for according to this explanation] the dakka effects neither prohibition nor permission.

Tosafot on Eruvin 89b:9:1.hebrew: וקטן נפרץ במילואו - כגון שהגג קטן נכנס לתוך הגדול, כדאוקימנא פרק קמא (דף ט:) דמתניתין דחצר קטנה שנפרצה לגדולה — בנכנסין כותלי קטנה לגדולה, שלא יהא נראה מבחוץ ושוה מבפנים:
Tosafot on Eruvin 89b:9:1.english: "And the small [roof] is fully breached" - Such as where the small roof enters into the large one, just as we established in the first chapter (9b) that the Mishnah of a small courtyard that was breached into a large one [is dealing with a case where] the walls of the small one enter into the large one, so that it will not be [a case of] visible from the outside and flush from the inside.
